description: This file is a shell script used for testing various functionalities of Git repositories, including cloning, referencing, object management, and handling of special filesystem cases such as symlinks and garbage objects. It defines functions to create repositories, make commits, and perform tests with assertions, and then executes a series of test cases to validate Git behaviors.

methods.name: commit_in
methods.description: Creates a commit in a specified repository with a given filename and content.

methods.name: test_objcount
methods.description: Checks the number of loose objects in a repository.
